title: Privacy Policy
disclaimer: This is not legal advice. This policy describes how platform metadata is handled.

sections.title: Data Collected
sections.text: We store business questionnaire data, order metadata, and notification logs.

sections.title: Retention
sections.text: Deliverable files are temporary. Order metadata may be retained according to platform policy.

sections.title: Customer Responsibility
sections.text: Customers must download and store deliverables before automatic cleanup.
